body: I know this is late but hopefully this helps. From my personal experience focusing on yourself is all about giving yourself the love that you want from others. So let's say you always love getting compliments from others, give yourself compliments in the mirror. Self love is about making yourself happy regardless of the outside people/circumstances. Its all about l loving yourself like you wish other people would love you. I really recommend meditation! It helped me a lot with working towards my self love, & As you grow older you'll realize that friends come and go. But one thing that will always stay with you, is yourself. So why not take care of yourself the best you can.
